text: Selection Actions 是面向 DSH Web GUI 的对话引用插件。用户在对话内容中选中一段文字后，可通过浮动工具栏将片段作为引用加入当前会话草稿，或在并行聊天中继续追问。加入草稿的引用会序列化为带引用标记的 Markdown 区块；草稿上方显示引用数量，悬停可查看片段并移除本插件添加的引用。发送后的引用会在对话记录中呈现为引用卡片。并行聊天会尝试复制当前会话并打开右侧侧栏，无法使用时回退为同一工作区的新会话。插件逻辑运行在 Web 客户端，无需额外配置。

Selection Actions is a DSH Web plugin for quoting selected conversation text. Add an excerpt to the current draft or open a parallel chat. Quotes serialize as Markdown and render as transcript cards; the composer strip previews and removes citations. No extra configuration is required.
我想把对话里的一段原文引用到正在写的消息中。
能不能选中聊天内容，再带着这段上下文开一个并行会话？
让网页聊天可以把选中的片段整理成发送消息里的引用。
草稿里加了好几段引用后，想查看内容并快速移除。
I want to quote a passage from the conversation in my next message.
Can I continue a question in a parallel chat with the selected excerpt?
Show sent conversation quotes as readable cards instead of raw quote lines.
Selection Actions 的功能「当前聊天引用」：选中对话文本后，浮动工具栏提供“Add to chat”操作，把片段作为引用芯片加入当前会话草稿；发送时芯片会变成引用区块。
Selection Actions 的功能「并行侧聊」：选择“Add in side chat”后，插件尝试 fork 当前 Session 并在右侧侧栏打开副本，再把同一引用放入新草稿；侧栏不可用时改为创建同工作区的新会话。
Selection Actions 的功能「引用预览与清除」：草稿中的引用条显示引用数量，悬停或聚焦可预览各段内容；移除按钮清除插件添加的引用。
Selection Actions 的功能「引用卡片展示」：发送后的引用区块会在对话记录中匹配并渲染为带摘录和来源标签的卡片。
How can I keep an excerpt attached as a quote when I send my next chat message?

[](LICENSE)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) Web GUI plugin: select any fragment of a
conversation and turn it into a citation in the message you are about to send — or open it in a parallel chat.

English | [Русский](#русский)

dsh-selection-actions README · What it does：1. **Selection toolbar.** Select text in the conversation and a small toolbar appears next to the selection:
   `Add to chat` and `Add in side chat`.
2. **Add to chat** stages the fragment in the current composer. The draft shows a compact
   `N conversation selections` strip with a remove control; hovering it slides out the staged citations.
   When you send, each fragment becomes a blockquote in the prompt — the model reads it as quoted context.
3. **Sent citations render as cards.** The transcript replaces the raw `> …` block with a card
   (quote glyph, excerpt, “Quote from the conversation”), so neither you nor the model sees a wall of markdown.
4. **Add in side chat** forks the current Session, opens the copy in the right Sidebar as a parallel chat and
   stages the same citation there, so follow-up questions do not pollute the main thread.

dsh-selection-actions README · Install：The plugin is a bundle: the Host half is empty, everything lives in the Web client. Install it with the
harness plugin manager, from this checkout or straight from GitHub:

```
dsh-selection-actions README · from npm：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add dsh-selection-actions
dsh-selection-actions README · from a local checkout：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add /path/to/dsh-selection-actions

dsh-selection-actions README · from this repository：dsh plugin --profile <profile> add https://github.com/ccclosed/dsh-selection-actions
```

Then reload the Web GUI page. It is a per-profile installation and survives restarts.

dsh-selection-actions README · Install from the plugin market (no npm account, one URL)：The repository ships a [format-1 market index](market.json), so the plugin installs from a pinned commit
without npm. Add this URL under **Settings → Plugins → Discover → index sources**:

```
https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ccclosed/dsh-selection-actions/main/market.json
```

The version it lists installs as
`git+https://github.com/ccclosed/dsh-selection-actions.git#<commit>`, so an install is always reproducible.

dsh-selection-actions README · Known limitations：- The citation strip is attached to the composer card from the dock seat (see above) and overlaps its top
  edge by a few pixels rather than being a child of the card.
- The remove control clears this plugin’s citations only when the draft holds no foreign reference chips.
- `Add in side chat` reuses the shipped `subagentchat` Sidebar tab, so the tab title falls back to the fork’s
  Session id when the Session has no projected title yet.

сообщении либо открываешь его в параллельном чате.

dsh-selection-actions README · Русский：- **Add to chat** — фрагмент попадает в композер текущего чата. Над полем появляется плашка
  `N conversation selections`: по наведению из неё выезжают добавленные цитаты, крестик убирает их.
  При отправке каждый фрагмент становится блокквотом в запросе — модель читает его как цитируемый контекст.
- **Отправленная цитата рисуется карточкой** (кавычка, фрагмент, подпись «Цитата из переписки»), а не
  сырым `> …` текстом.
- **Add in side chat** — форк текущей сессии открывается отдельной вкладкой в правой панели, туда же
  подставляется цитата; основная ветка не засоряется.
